title: 応用バイオ専門実験・演習Ａ
subtitle: Applied Bioscience Major Lab/Exercises A
educationalGoal:
Student will: acquire scientific insight through basic lectures and exercises;
learn how to write scientific reports; learn the logical considerations for
methods, results, and discussion; and learn presentation techniques.
The goal of this course is to introduce life science students to the skills of observation and enquiry.
advice:
Student will work under the following three themes to acquire information and learn experimental techniques for "sensory function", "behavioral principles" and "bicrobiological production technology".

(1) Nerve cell morphology: from microscopic observation to quantitative evaluation
(2) Microbiological production with fermentation and microbial transformation
requiredKnowledge:
(1) Expertise acquired via related lectures
(2) Reading of distributed text materials
